landmark.help.title: Get the map data
landmark.help.intro: The mod cannot download the web map itself, so you export it once from your own browser. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: the script only reads the map page you already have open and saves a zip on your computer.
landmark.help.step1: 1. Click Open map website. It opens in your browser; finish any security check it shows.
landmark.help.step2: 2. In the browser press F12 and choose the Console tab. If it warns about pasting, type: allow pasting  and press Enter.
landmark.help.step3: 3. Come back here, click Copy export script, then paste into the console (Ctrl+V) and press Enter. Wait for it to say done; a file called landmark-export.zip downloads.
landmark.help.step4: 4. Drag landmark-export.zip onto this Minecraft window. The map updates immediately and the data is kept for next time.
landmark.help.drop: Drop the zip on this window to import it
landmark.list.none: No open spawns loaded. Press Refresh.
landmark.list.empty: No matches. You can still type an exact land name and teleport.
